key_insight: Matching rooftop solar generation with climate-shaped demand and EV battery storage can supply up to 84% of annual building and mobility electricity demand.
engineering_relevance: Urban PV–EV planning should evaluate hourly supply–demand alignment and storage flexibility rather than solar capacity factor alone.
method: Simulate rooftop PV integrated with EV batteries across 5,000 global grid cells.
Use hourly meteorology and climate-induced electricity demand.
Assess self-sufficiency and compare potential with capacity-factor-based screening.
evidence_signal: Simulations indicate that capacity-factor-only screening undervalues PV–EV potential in 21.9% of the world's 1,000 most populous cities, with strong potential in many low-latitude cities.
watch_item: Real-world performance depends on EV availability for storage and charging coordination; the abstract does not report field validation.
paper_title: Climate-Driven Supply-Demand Matching Reshapes Global SolarEV Decarbonization Potential
